comments.author: dovlex11
comments.body:
Nice work!
Btw that speed of texturing 1024x1024 is crazy.
Im usualy waiting for 10 min.

replies.author: ai_happy
replies.body:
1024 is only needed for multiview projection. For single camera we can use 768 or even 512.   
Remember that we texture only 1 side. There will be other sides, also 512. So the final uv texture will end up at least 2k anyway.

comments.author: ratzschaf
comments.body: I tried out your software last week. It works great and offers really great possibilities. However, I have a few wishes for the future: It would be really practical to have a copy stamp for corrections. Some textures, such as half-timbered structures, are rendered unrealistically on a model and require a lot of correction. It would be really good if this could be done manually directly in the software. Perhaps the support of Flux including the appropriate controlnets for normal and depth would be helpful. Are there also plans to generate realistic PBR materials? If you have a finished texture, I think the next step would be to generate realistic maps from it. This is something your software could be very good at.
